    def get_cookies(board):
        board = tuple(sorted(board))
        if board in memo:
            return memo[board]
        
        s = sum(board)
        if not board:
            return 0
        max_val = max(board)
        if max_val > s - max_val or s == 0:
            return len(board)
        
        # A wants to maximize the number of cookies.
        # B wants to minimize it.
        res = 0
        # A chooses x and y
        possible_results = []
        n = len(board)
        for i in range(n):
            for j in range(i + 1, n):
                x = board[i]
                y = board[j]
                
                # B chooses b = x+y or b = |x-y|
                # B will choose the one that minimizes the cookies.
                res_x_plus_y = get_cookies(list(board[:i] + board[i+1:j] + board[j:] + [x+y]))

        memo[board] = res
        return res
